messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — shared the joint SI solution brief and localized assets here: https://rdwx.io/partner-assets/si-brief-v2.zip. Need a quick pass on logos, lockups, and the German/French copies before we send to Contoso for approval. :eyes:
Samir Patel: thanks — downloading. Is there a single source of truth for the lockup (Redwood + Contoso)? I only see 3 variations in Figma.
Leo Kim: Figma file has: horizontal lockup, stacked lockup, marketplace badge. CC @DesignBot for exact spacing rules.
DesignBot: Redwood brand clearspace = 24px at 72dpi. Partner lockup guideline: 1.5x partner logo height spacing on left/right. Use SVGs from /logos/svgs/ — do not rasterize.
Jay O'Neill: Legal note: partner provided trademark usage doc requires the partner logo be unchanged and include ™ where present. Also, any customer quote needs written approval from their comms team before publication.
Anya Rivera: For the marketplace listing icons (AWS/GCP/Azure), do we have the marketplace-specific icon sizes? I can generate the ZIP if you confirm sizes.
Leo Kim: Marketplace sizes: 128x128, 64x64, 32x32. Use neutral bg #FFFFFF, no drop shadows per marketplace rules. I'll prep exports.
Maria Chen: Localization question — Contoso wants the German and French PDFs. Samir, can you confirm the translated strings are final? We had one line that references "sensitive data" that might need legal review.
Samir Patel: Confirmed translations attached in the ZIP under i18n/. I flagged the "sensitive data" line and left a comment for Jay.
Jay O'Neill: Got the comment. Suggested alternative phrasing: "data requiring regulatory controls". That should be safer.
Leo Kim: Small visual: partner logo is too close to callout box on p4 in the DE version. Recommend +12px top margin, and switch callout bg to #F6F7FB for contrast.
Maria Chen: Good catch. Also — Contoso's brand guide asks we use their tagline with title case. Samir, please ensure the tagline in DE/FR follows their capitalization.
Samir Patel: Will do. Quick ask: tracking — Anya, can you confirm UTM pattern for co-marketing CTAs? We want marketplace -> brief -> lead form tracing.
Anya Rivera: Use utm_source=contoso&utm_medium=partner-campaign&utm_campaign=si-brief-q2. I'll add unique utm_content per region (de/fr/en).
Maria Chen: One more: do we have a one-page co-branded social image for joint announcement? Need final by EOD so Contoso can sign off tomorrow.
Leo Kim: I can mock one up by 3pm. Prefer a neutral gradient + left-aligned logos. I'll post Figma link when ready. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll queue the quote approvals and ping Contoso comms. If they approve the quote and trademark use, we should be able to publish next week.
Jay O'Neill: After they approve, I'll do a final legal sign-off on the brief and marketplace description.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Thanks all — next steps: Leo uploads updated assets to the ZIP, Samir updates translations, Anya prepares tracking links. I'll consolidate and send to Contoso. :raised_hands:
